info.name: Video Downloader API
info.description:
Standalone yt-dlp extraction API.

Set the `BaseUrl` and `ApiKey` collection variables before running anything.

Auth is inherited from the collection and sent as `x-api-key`. `Authorization: Bearer <key>` is accepted too.

Every extraction endpoint returns a `media[]` array. Check `needs_conversion` on the entry you pick: when it is `true` the URL is an HLS playlist, not a file — pass it to `Downloads / HLS to MP4` and download the `file_url` that comes back.

request.description: Open probe. No API key required.
Any yt-dlp-supported site: Facebook, YouTube, Twitter/X, Reddit and so on. Login-gated sources need a cookies.txt uploaded first.

TikTok rate-limits anonymous extraction, so the server retries internally up to TIKTOK_RETRIES times. Expect 5-20s. Each media entry carries `headers` and `cookies` that the client MUST replay on the download request, or the CDN returns 403.
Requires a valid cookies.txt on the server (see Update cookies).

Step 1 of 2. No `quality` param, so this returns metadata + available_qualities and NO media array. Metadata probe only: nothing is downloaded, answers in seconds.

requires_quality:true means show a picker, then call step 2 with the chosen value.

item.name: Vimeo - step 2: convert at a quality

query.description: REQUIRED to get a file. best|1080|720|480|360|240 — nothing above 1080p

request.description:
Step 2 of 2. With `quality`, returns media[] with one ready mp4 and NO available_qualities.

This is a real download — set Postman's request timeout to 300000ms. A 13-minute Vimeo at 240p measured 159s.

An invalid quality (2160, 1440, 999) returns 400 immediately.
Old behavior: fast, metadata-only, every entry needs_conversion=true. Feed one to Downloads / HLS to MP4 yourself if you want a client-driven quality picker instead of the server's automatic choice.

Step 1 of 2. No `quality` param, so this returns metadata + available_qualities and NO media array. Nothing is downloaded.

Also handles Pinterest.

item.name: Dailymotion - step 2: convert at a quality

query.description: REQUIRED to get a file. best|1080|720|480|360|240 — nothing above 1080p

request.description: Step 2 of 2. With `quality`, returns media[] with one ready mp4 and NO available_qualities. Measured 14s at 480p for a 51-second clip.

Takes an m3u8 URL from a media entry with needs_conversion=true, remuxes it to mp4 and returns { file_url, key, expires_in }. Fetch file_url directly — it needs no API key and is deleted when the TTL expires.

Converted files on disk: count, total size, and when each is deleted (soonest first). Requires x-api-key.

auto_delete:false / orphaned_count > 0 means files the in-memory cache is no longer tracking — every container restart strands the files it was tracking, and those are never removed automatically. Clear them with Delete video or rm on the host.

`disk` reports free space on the volume holding DOWNLOADS_DIR, which on the VPS is shared with Postgres and MinIO.
Removes a converted file ahead of its TTL.

DESTRUCTIVE. Deletes every converted file in DOWNLOADS_DIR immediately, including orphans a restart stranded and stray .ts intermediates.

The method must be DELETE — GET and POST return 404 on purpose, so a prefetch or stray click cannot wipe the server.

Does not cancel work in flight: a conversion already running still writes its output, and a client mid-download of a cleared file gets a truncated transfer. Everything is regenerable by re-requesting it.

Run Storage status first to see what will go. Check failed_count, not just the status code.
